result_text:
A sub-landscape without a readable `config.json` no longer aborts the parent landscape report. The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests and didn't generate a report to check the missing-config case.

The change is in `LandscapeReportGenerator.java`, in the sub-landscape table loop. `getSubLandscapeConfig` already catches the read error and returns `null`, but the loop then called `getMetadata()` on that `null`, which caused the NullPointerException. The loop now falls back to an empty `Metadata` when the config or its metadata is `null`. An empty `Metadata` has no logo link, so the existing code renders the default landscape logo. The row keeps its link to the index page, and its figures are filled in or left empty as before.

Sub-landscapes that have a config go through the same code as before, so they keep their own logo.
